svg.text: Voice Assistant Flow (Mermaid source in voice-flow.mmd)

foreignObject.pre: flowchart TD A[User taps Voice UI (`AIAssistantSection`)] --> B{Mic Permission?} B -- Yes --> C[Start local STT (Web Speech API)\nInterim + final transcripts] B -- No --> F[Show typed fallback / request permission] C --> D[Client UX layer] D --> D1[Deduplicate & short-confirm handling] D --> D2[Persist draft → `localStorage`] D --> E{Confidence OK?} E -- High --> H[Use local transcript for intent extraction] E -- Low / Needs accuracy --> G[Stream audio → Deepgram (real-time ASR / diarization / punctuation / custom models)] G --> I[Deepgram returns enriched transcript + metadata] H --> J[Normalize transcript → structured fields (name/phone/service/date/time/confirm)] I --> J J --> K[/POST /ai/voice-book or /ai/voice-book/guest/] K --> L[Backend validate & check slots / business rules] L --> M{Create booking?} M -- Yes --> N[Create DB record (Booking) & persist transcript ref] N --> O[Send confirmation email (emailService.js) — mark: "Confirmed via Voice Assistant"] M -- No --> P[Return error / suggest alternatives] O --> Q[Return JSON success] P --> Q Q --> R[Client TTS announces result & updates UI] R --> S[User sees confirmation + email] T[Transcripts & metadata indexed] --- U[GROQ queries for context, search, analytics]
